analysis.environment_identity_enforcement: STRICT enforcement on reference_bank_match and same_environment_threshold=0.98; failure triggers similar_environment then fallback_environment degradation.
analysis.object_identity_enforcement: STRICT for hero_prop, MEDIUM for scene_prop; success requires identity_signature match within variation_tolerance band; failure triggers similar_object degradation.
analysis.temporal_preservation_enforcement: STRICT enforcement on edit_rhythm_signature and continuity_signature; failure triggers fallback_text_path with NOT_PRODUCTION_REPLICA.
analysis.camera_continuity_enforcement: MEDIUM enforcement on motion_vector smoothing and camera_inertia anchors; bounded drift permitted with logged warnings.
analysis.multi_scene_consistency_enforcement: STRICT enforcement on environment_anchors and object_anchors cross-scene persistence; failure triggers scene_remap lineage audit before degradation.

enforcement_validation_contract.scope: Protocol definition only — no GPU execution or image generation in this phase.
enforcement_validation_contract.validation_unit: Per runtime_channel batch validation with minimum_validation_batch_size samples.
enforcement_validation_contract.pass_threshold: All success_conditions met for batch; any failure_condition triggers degradation path audit.
enforcement_validation_contract.certification_scope: Enforcement Defined != Enforcement Proven; Measurement Defined != Validation Passed.

enforcement_success_conditions.reference_bank_match: Environment or object reference bank entry resolves by primary key with score >= same_environment/same_object threshold.
enforcement_success_conditions.identity_signature_match: identity_signature hash matches bound reference bank entry within variation_tolerance band.
enforcement_success_conditions.edit_rhythm_alignment: Generated shot duration within edit_rhythm_binding shot_duration_ms tolerance band.
enforcement_success_conditions.continuity_signature_stable: Shot boundary continuity_signature stable across adjacent generated frames.
enforcement_success_conditions.camera_inertia_preserved: Motion vector magnitude delta below camera_continuity MEDIUM drift bound.
enforcement_success_conditions.cross_scene_anchor_stable: environment_anchors and object_anchors persistence_score >= 0.85 across scene boundary.

enforcement_failure_conditions.reference_drift: Reference bank match score drops below similarity_threshold.
enforcement_failure_conditions.geometry_mismatch: Anchor normalized_position delta exceeds STRICT bound.
enforcement_failure_conditions.style_overrides_identity: Style conditioning weight dominates identity reference weight.
enforcement_failure_conditions.edit_rhythm_desync: Shot duration deviates beyond edit_rhythm tolerance.
enforcement_failure_conditions.camera_inertia_break: Camera motion vector jump exceeds MEDIUM bound.
enforcement_failure_conditions.cross_scene_memory_loss: Anchor persistence_score drops below multi_scene threshold.

runtime_degradation_rules.strict_channel_abort: STRICT channel failure aborts channel and executes expected_degradation_path before continuing batch.
runtime_degradation_rules.medium_channel_warn: MEDIUM channel failure logs warning and continues if drift within secondary bound.
runtime_degradation_rules.degradation_order: primary channel degradation → adapter fallback → ConditionedPromptBuilder → NOT_PRODUCTION_REPLICA.
runtime_degradation_rules.similar_not_same: similar_environment and similar_object paths must never be treated as identity lock without threshold gate.
runtime_degradation_rules.single_image_not_movie: Single Image Success != Movie Reconstruction Success — batch validation required per minimum_validation_batch_size.
